headline: STAY on X.1
why: No X.1 trade today: the bot started at 09:42 ET, after the 09:35-09:40 entry window (2nd missed open in a row). Had it run, X.1 would have shorted the red opening candle near 26717 with a wide 427-pt stop and closed at 15:50 near 26888, about -0.4R (~-$345). Two live trades so far, both -1R; too few to judge, so no change.
